problem: min 0.5 ||M-U V^T||_F^2, U>=0, V>=0, each U column has at most tau nonzeros. No spectral bounds.

optimizer.name: SPRING-SARAH empirical author-code control
optimizer.block_rule: Fixed contiguous blocks, floor(length/20) each, last block absorbs remainder; independent shuffled row and column orders per outer cycle.
optimizer.outer_cycle_1: 20 alternating plain stochastic gradient block updates.
optimizer.outer_cycles_after_1: One alternating full gradient refresh/step, then 20 alternating SARAH differences.
optimizer.power_method: 5 normalized power iterations initialized with a fresh Gaussian vector, then ||M^T M v||; original two unused calls retained.
optimizer.outer_sparsity: Keep tau largest raw entries of each U column, then clip negatives.
optimizer.inner_sparsity: Hard threshold at tau-th absolute magnitude with STRICT >, then clip negatives; generally retains at most tau-1. This is not the exact nonnegative+l0 projection.
optimizer.initialization: Saved author Ain and xin, including negative entries, unchanged.
optimizer.source_epoch_axis: 2 times outer cycles. Warmup consumes 2 full residual passes; later cycles consume 6 including full refresh and old/current differences.
optimizer.our_control_repeats: Chosen externally by root; each invocation is one NumPy seed.
optimizer.loss: 0.5 * squared Frobenius reconstruction residual; source plots log10(loss).

faithfulness_limits: Python port uses NumPy PCG64, not MATLAB RNG; saved initial factors are identical but stochastic draw sequence differs.

Original fea arrays are uint8. Demo omits double cast before normalization. Port explicitly casts to FP64 to implement intended per-image unit-L2 normalization; literal bundled MATLAB script is not claimed executable unchanged.
No MATLAB or Octave installed, so validation is source inspection plus synthetic behavioral/restart checks, not MATLAB cross-execution.
Supplied ORL demo horizon is 250 source epochs; final paper ORL figure uses 1000, so the current control is a source-demo control, not an exact final-figure replication.

Empirical author-code control is not theorem matched: shuffled blocks, deterministic refresh, practical power-estimate steps, and hard-threshold/clipping order differ from convergence-theorem prescriptions.
Our output also records residual-entry work including refresh and old-gradient costs; diagnostic evaluations and checkpoint I/O excluded from optimizer_seconds.
